svg.title: ABTalks Day 2 premium Prompt Engineering infographic
svg.desc: Premium square infographic comparing a weak prompt and its basic output on the left with an engineered prompt and its better output on the right, connected by a central banner reading Better Prompt equals Better AI Response, in brown, beige, cream, white and soft gold colors with chat bubbles, AI chip icon, sparkles and neural network line decorations.
svg.text: Better Prompts. Better Results. Better Productivity.
